leadText: Leaf Forest (Japanese: リーフの森 Leaf Forest) is an -exclusive forest in Kanto, featured in The March of the Exeggutor Squad. It is located between the and Cinnabar Island. It has a large population of . The area functions similar to a Leaf Stone, causing some species of Pokémon to evolve without warning.
